bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / REGIONAL RURAL BANKS
bid.reason: The tender is for an Enterprise Fraud Risk Management (EFRM) solution focused on real-time transaction monitoring and fraud detection, not Anti-Money Laundering (AML) software for sanctions screening or customer risk assessment.

evidence.quote: This is to certify that approval has been accorded for exemption from MSE and MIl Purchase Preference in respect of the procurement of Enterprise Fraud Risk Management (EFRM) Solution, cross channel control platform including cyber complaint processing, CCCP / NCRP / I4C integration and ML based money mule accounts detection solution
Proposed solution should have the capability to identify suspicious employee activities (balance enquiries, exceptions, TODs, charge waivers etc.) based on the real-time transaction monitoring.

Proposed solution should be able to detect & prevent following fraud schemes including but not limited to: Transaction Velocity Check, Suspicious Beneficiary registrations and unusual funds transfer, Sudden Transaction Amount Surge compared to established customer/account profile

key_facts.scope_summary: Enterprise Fraud Risk Management (EFRM) Solution for real-time transaction monitoring and fraud detection across banking channels.
